title: Cost-Efficient Theorem Proving via Agent Orchestration in Program Verification

paragraphs.en: Program verification establishes software correctness through machine-checkable proofs constructed in theorem provers. It’s a guarantee especially valuable for code generated by large language models (LLMs), which is fluent but carries no assurance of correctness. Almost all existing provers, however, pursue pass rates alone at whatever sampling or search budget it takes, and overlook the success-vs-cost frontier ; yet real software often carries hundreds of interdependent proof obligations, so what matters at scale is not whether one theorem can be proved, but how many can be proved economically. We introduce CoCo-Prover , which formalizes cost-efficient program proving as metalevel decision-making under cost, grounded on two-level proof graphs : an AND/OR proof hypergraph within each declaration is joined to a lemma-dependency graph across declarations; and at each step, it answers two questions: which open goals to select, and which actions to purchase on these goals. Selection stays symbolic as a topological pass over the proof graphs. Action choice is agent orchestration via metalevel decision-making: an agentic router treats every bounded specialist invocation as a separately priced, best-effort computation, matching heterogeneous specialist agents together with configurations, under evolved routing rules as evidence accumulates. On five program verification benchmarks in Lean 4 including function-level CLEVER, VERINA, and AlgoVeri, and repository-level NTP4VC and Vero, we show that CoCo-Prover achieves a better success-vs-cost frontier than baselines including frontier coding agents and state-of-the-art LLM-based provers: it achieves the best solve rate on every benchmark and up to 100% on two benchmarks. It also reduces cost by up to 30.9% compared to the strongest baseline with the strongest LLM in our evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 程序验证通过定理证明器中构建的机器可验证证明来确立软件的正确性。 对于由大型语言模型（LLM）生成的代码而言，这种保证尤其宝贵，因为这类代码虽然流畅，但没有任何正确性的保障。 然而，几乎所有现有的证明器都只追求通过率，无论需要多少采样或搜索资源，并忽视了成功与成本之间的权衡边界；但实际上，软件往往包含数百个相互依赖的证明义务，因此在大规模场景下重要的不是能否证明一个定理，而是能以经济高效的方式证明多少个定理。 我们提出了 CoCo-Prover，它将成本高效的程序证明形式化为一种基于成本约束的元层决策过程，其基础是双层证明图：每个声明内部的 AND/OR 证明超图与跨声明的引理依赖图相连接；在每一步中，它会回答两个问题：选择哪些未解决的目标，以及在这些目标上购买哪些操作。 选择过程作为对证明图的一种拓扑遍历，始终保持符号化形式。 操作的选择则通过元层决策实现智能体协同：一个智能体路由器将每个受限制的专业专家调用视为一个独立定价、尽力而为的计算任务，在证据逐步积累的过程中，依据演化出的路由规则将异构的专业专家智能体与其配置相匹配。 在 Lean 4 中的五个程序验证基准测试上——包括函数级的 CLEVER、VERINA 和 AlgoVeri，以及仓库级的 NTP4VC 和 Vero——我们展示了 CoCo-Prover 在成功与成本权衡边界上优于基线模型（包括前沿编码智能体和当前最先进的 LLM 基证明器）：它在所有基准测试中均实现了最佳的解决率，并在两个基准测试中达到了 100%。 与评估中最强的、使用最强 LLM 的基线模型相比，它还将成本降低了最多 30.9%。

paragraphs.en: Program verification uses formal mathematical reasoning to establish that a program satisfies specified correctness properties [ 11 , 15 ] , providing guarantees that testing, which examines only finitely many executions, cannot offer. Historically, obtaining such guarantees has been expensive, requiring substantial expert effort to construct machine-checkable proofs in interactive theorem provers (ITPs) such as Lean 4 [ 32 ] , Rocq [ 45 ] , and Isabelle/HOL [ 33 ] . Large language models (LLMs) create an opportunity to reduce this burden: while they can now generate sophisticated programs from natural-language specifications [ 8 , 2 ] , they may also automate the costly process of constructing formal proofs. This possibility has motivated verified code generation [ 42 , 52 ] , where a model generates a program with a machine-checkable proof proving it satisfies the specification. Nevertheless, proof generation remains considerably harder than code generation shown in recent benchmarks VERINA [ 54 ] , CLEVER [ 43 ] , and AlgoVeri [ 57 ] . Proof generation has therefore emerged as a central bottleneck in program verification and verified code generation.
paragraphs.zh: 程序验证利用正式的数学推理来确立一个程序是否满足指定的正确性属性 [ 11 , 15 ] ，从而提供测试（仅能检查有限次数的执行）无法提供的保证。 从历史上看，获得此类保证成本高昂，需要在交互式定理证明器（如 Lean 4 [ 32 ]、Rocq [ 45 ] 和 Isabelle/HOL [ 33 ]）中投入大量专家精力来构建机器可验证的证明。 大型语言模型（LLM）为减轻这一负担提供了机会：尽管它们现在能够根据自然语言规范生成复杂的程序 [ 8 , 2 ] ，但它们也可能实现构建形式化证明这一成本高昂的自动化过程。 这种可能性推动了已验证代码的生成 [ 42 , 52 ]，即模型会生成一个附带机器可验证证明的程序，以证明其满足既定规范。 然而，在近期的基准测试 VERINA [ 54 ]、CLEVER [ 43 ] 和 AlgoVeri [ 57 ] 中，证明生成仍然比代码生成困难得多。 因此，证明生成已成为程序验证和已验证代码生成的核心瓶颈。

paragraphs.en: Real software magnifies this bottleneck. A repository can contain hundreds or thousands of proof obligations with sharply different proof economics [ 50 , 53 ] . At the same time, a generated proof serves only to verify its program: the checker returns exactly one of two outcomes, and every accepted proof certifies equally. Thus, the natural objective for scalable program verification is the success–vs–cost frontier —the Pareto frontier between proof success and token cost ( or monetary expenditure practically), measured as success under matched cost limits and cost at matched success.
paragraphs.zh: 真正的软件会放大这一瓶颈。 一个仓库可能包含数百甚至数千个证明义务，而这些证明的经济性差异巨大 [ 50 , 53 ] 。 同时，生成的证明仅用于验证其程序：检查器只会返回两种结果之一，且每个被接受的证明都具有同等效力。 因此，可扩展程序验证的自然目标在于成功与成本之间的边界——即证明成功与代币成本（或实际上的货币支出）之间的帕累托前沿，具体表现为在匹配的成本限制下的成功率，以及在匹配的成功率下的成本。

paragraphs.en: Recent LLM-based theorem provers have shown substantial promise, particularly in mathematical reasoning [ 36 , 27 , 1 , 48 , 9 ] . Code proving, however, presents a different challenge Figure 1(a) . Each task introduces a fresh formal context ( e.g. , the implementation, specification, and often new data types and definitions) and proving correctness requires reasoning about the program’s intermediate states. While program syntax often determines the overall proof structure and many side conditions can be discharged mechanically, a few critical obligations require discovering facts not explicit in the program or specification ( e.g. , the right loop invariant, a sufficiently generalized induction hypothesis). These discoveries often determine whether the entire proof succeeds, yet they are precisely the steps that require substantial semantic reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 近期基于大型语言模型的定理证明器展现出巨大潜力，尤其是在数学推理方面 [ 36 , 27 , 1 , 48 , 9 ] 。 然而，代码证明则呈现出不同的挑战（图 1(a)）。 每个任务都会引入一个新的形式化语境（例如：实现、规范，以及常常涉及新的数据类型和定义），而正确性证明则需要对程序的中间状态进行推理。 尽管程序语法通常决定了整体证明结构，许多侧条件也可以被机械地验证，但少数关键义务仍需发现程序中或规范中未明确说明的事实（例如：合适的循环不变量、足够泛化的归纳假设）。 这些发现往往决定整个证明能否成功，而它们恰恰是需要大量语义推理的步骤。

paragraphs.en: This asymmetry creates a distinctive opportunity for code proving: most obligations are routine, but a small number are both difficult and decisive. Existing code provers [ 14 , 47 , 58 , 23 ] , however, largely ignore this asymmetry, pursuing provability through large sampling or iterative repair budgets and applying similar model-driven procedures across subgoals. Such strategies are particularly costly with frontier general-purpose LLMs and waste substantial computation on obligations that theorem-prover automation or inexpensive model calls could solve directly ( Figure 1 ). Effective code proving therefore requires not simply more reasoning, but identifying where deep reasoning matters and concentrating model computation there.
paragraphs.zh: 这种不对称性为代码证明创造了一个独特的机会：大多数义务都是例行的，但少数义务既困难又具有决定性意义。 然而，现有的代码证明器 [ 14 , 47 , 58 , 23 ] 在很大程度上忽视了这种不对称性，它们通过大规模采样或迭代修复预算来追求可证明性，并在各个子目标中应用类似的模型驱动流程。 对于前沿通用 LLM 而言，这类策略成本尤其高昂，并且会浪费大量计算资源在那些定理证明自动化或低成本模型调用就能直接解决的问题上（图 1）。 因此，有效的代码证明不仅需要更多的推理，还需要识别出深度推理至关重要的位置，并将模型计算集中于此。

paragraphs.en: To address this challenge, we introduce CoCo-Prover, a cost-aware prover that adapts its strategy and reasoning effort to the evolving proof state. Rather than applying the same proof routine to every obligation, CoCo-Prover repeatedly decides what to prove next and how to prove it: whether an obligation can be discharged mechanically, needs direct proof generation, benefits from introducing a reusable helper lemma, or requires recovery from an unproductive proof path. It also controls how much reasoning effort to spend on each action. To make these decisions globally, CoCo-Prover maintains a two-level proof graph that tracks both fine-grained proof progress and dependencies among lemmas. We formalize this process as metalevel decision-making under cost : each proving action is a computation with a cost and an uncertain, verifier-judged outcome, and the prover must decide which computation is worth performing given the current proof state [ 39 ] . CoCo-Prover realizes this formulation through an agentic router and four specialized proving agents, using the proof graph and accumulated verifier feedback to adapt its strategy as proving progresses. This turns code proving from a fixed proof-search routine into adaptive orchestration of heterogeneous proving strategies under cost.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们提出了 CoCo-Prover——一种成本感知型证明器，它会根据不断变化的证明状态调整其策略和推理投入。 CoCo-Prover 不会对每个义务都采用相同的证明流程，而是反复决定接下来要证明什么以及如何证明：某个义务能否通过机械方式完成，是否需要直接生成证明，是否适合引入可重用的辅助引理，或者是否需要从一条无益的证明路径中恢复。 它还会控制每次操作所投入的推理努力程度。 为实现全局决策，CoCo-Prover 维护了一个双层证明图，用于追踪精细的证明进展以及引理之间的依赖关系。 我们将这一过程形式化为成本约束下的元层决策：每次证明操作都是一次具有成本和不确定结果的计算，该结果由验证器评判；证明器必须根据当前证明状态决定执行哪项计算 [39]。 CoCo-Prover 通过一个智能体路由器和四个专业证明智能体实现了这一框架，并利用证明图与累积的验证器反馈，在证明过程中动态调整策略。 这使得代码证明从固定的证明搜索流程，转变为在成本约束下对异构证明策略的自适应协调。

sents.en: To make these decisions globally, CoCo-Prover maintains a two-level proof graph that tracks both fine-grained proof progress and dependencies among lemmas.

sents.en: We formalize this process as metalevel decision-making under cost : each proving action is a computation with a cost and an uncertain, verifier-judged outcome, and the prover must decide which computation is worth performing given the current proof state [ 39 ] .
sents.zh: 我们将这一过程形式化为成本约束下的元层决策：每次证明操作都是一次具有成本和不确定结果的计算，该结果由验证器评判；证明器必须根据当前证明状态决定执行哪项计算 [39]。

sents.en: CoCo-Prover realizes this formulation through an agentic router and four specialized proving agents, using the proof graph and accumulated verifier feedback to adapt its strategy as proving progresses.
sents.zh: CoCo-Prover 通过一个智能体路由器和四个专业证明智能体实现了这一框架，并利用证明图与累积的验证器反馈，在证明过程中动态调整策略。

sents.en: This turns code proving from a fixed proof-search routine into adaptive orchestration of heterogeneous proving strategies under cost.
sents.zh: 这使得代码证明从固定的证明搜索流程，转变为在成本约束下对异构证明策略的自适应协调。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate CoCo-Prover on five Lean program verification benchmarks (function-level CLEVER [ 43 ] , VERINA [ 54 ] , and AlgoVeri [ 57 ] , and repository-level NTP4VC [ 51 ] and Vero [ 53 ] ) against state-of-the-art open-source agentic provers, and each model’s official coding agent, with three frontier LLMs under matched caps. No baseline exceeds CoCo-Prover’s solve rate on any benchmark and backbone: it solves up to 100% of function-level benchmarks and 60.5% of the large repository-level benchmark Vero while reduces cost by up to 30.9% against the strongest baseline, Humanize on the strongest backbone LLM, GPT-5.6-Terra.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在五个 Lean 程序验证基准（函数级 CLEVER [43]、VERINA [54] 和 AlgoVeri [57]，以及仓库级 NTP4VC [51] 和 Vero [53]）上，将 CoCo-Prover 与当前最先进的开源智能体证明器以及每个模型的官方编码智能体进行了对比测试，测试中使用了三种前沿 LLM 并在相同限制条件下运行。 在任何基准和模型架构上，都没有任何基线模型能超越 CoCo-Prover 的解决率：它能解决高达 100% 的函数级基准和 60.5% 的大型仓库级基准 Vero，同时与最强基线模型 Humanize（在最强骨干 LLM GPT-5.6-Terra 上运行）相比，成本最多可降低 30.9%。

paragraphs.en: In summary, our contributions are: i) Cost-efficient code proving. We pose cost efficiency, rather than provability alone, as the objective for theorem proving in program verification at the scale of real-world software. ii) Metalevel formulation under cost over two-level proof graphs. We are the first to formalize cost-efficient program proving as metalevel decision-making under cost, grounded on two-level proof graphs. And we instantiate it in CoCo-Prover with agent orchestration. iii) Success–cost evaluation. On five Lean benchmarks and three LLMs, no baseline exceeds CoCo-Prover’s solve rate in any setting, and it reduces cost by up to 30.9% against the strongest baseline.
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，我们的贡献包括：i) 成本高效的代码证明。 我们将成本效率而非仅可证性作为在真实世界软件规模上进行程序验证的定理证明目标。ii) 在双层证明图下考虑成本的元层构建。 我们是首个将成本高效的程序证明形式化为基于双层证明图的、受成本约束的元层决策方法的研究者。 并且我们在 CoCo-Prover 中通过智能体协调实现了这一方法。iii) 成功–成本评估。 在五个 Lean 基准测试和三种 LLM 上，没有任何基线模型在任何设置中的解决率超过 CoCo-Prover，且与最强的基线模型相比，其成本最多降低了 30.9%。

paragraphs.en: LLM-based provers. Fine-tuned provers generate whole Lean proofs and buy success through distributional sampling : correct proofs are spread across many samples and extracted at pass@ k k budgets by redrawing on unchanged context [ 26 , 49 , 27 ] , with decomposition, where present, confined to a single generation’s chain of thought [ 36 ] ; refinement agents temper this with verifier feedback yet still spend fixed per-theorem iteration budgets [ 44 , 37 , 59 , 31 , 29 ] . CoCo-Prover instead treats every bounded invocation as best-effort given its evidence and state, and resamples only as a separate decision justified by changed evidence. Structured provers including stepwise search over AND/OR tactic states [ 20 , 16 , 25 ] and lemma decomposition through pools, sketches, or blueprints [ 7 , 5 , 1 , 48 , 9 , 55 ] suffer from coarse rollback or rare reuse : a falsified conjecture triggers wholesale sketch or blueprint regeneration or outright branch failure, the rollback unit being the whole attempt rather than exactly the invalidated dependents, and helpers are rarely shared across distinct targets. CoCo-Prover’s persistent two-level proof graph instead provide fine-grained control over the rollback unit and the helper reuse. Code provers inherit both modes: NSPG runs one stepwise search per obligation under a flat timeout [ 14 ] , AutoRocq maintains a per-lemma proof tree [ 47 ] , LemmaNet discovers helper lemmas from program semantics into a flat corpus [ 58 ] , and Goedel-Code-Prover decomposes each verification task in isolation [ 23 ] , while the general coding agents merge these techniques but cost much [ 41 , 43 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型的证明器。 微调后的证明器会生成完整的 Lean 证明，并通过分布采样来提高成功率：正确的证明分散在众多样本中，通过 pass@k 预算在不变上下文的重新采样中提取 [26, 49, 27]；而分解（如果存在）则仅限于单次生成的思维链 [36]；精炼智能体虽借助验证器反馈对此进行缓和，但仍需为每个定理分配固定的迭代预算 [44, 37, 59, 31, 29]。 CoCo-Prover 则将每次有界调用视为基于其证据和状态的尽力而为操作，且仅在存在证据变化时，才作为独立决策进行重新采样。 结构化证明器（包括对 AND/OR 策略状态的分步搜索 [20, 16, 25]，以及通过池、草图或蓝图进行的引理分解 [7, 5, 1, 48, 9, 55]）存在粗略回滚或罕见复用问题：一个被证伪的猜想会触发整个草图或蓝图的再生，甚至导致分支彻底失败；此时回滚单位是整个尝试过程，而非仅被无效化的依赖部分，且辅助组件很少在不同目标间共享。 CoCo-Prover 的持久化两级证明图则能精细控制回滚单位和辅助组件的复用。 代码证明器同时继承了这两种模式：NSPG 在固定超时限制下为每个义务执行一次分步搜索 [14]；AutoRocq 维护每个引理的证明树 [47]；LemmaNet 从程序语义中识别辅助引理并整合到扁平语料库中 [58]；Goedel-Code-Prover 则独立分解每个验证任务 [23]；而通用编码智能体虽融合了这些技术，但成本高昂 [41, 43]。

paragraphs.en: Cost-aware inference and agent orchestration. Query-level routers and cascades choose a model from surface features of an isolated query [ 6 , 34 ] , and budget-aware tree search anneals exploration within a single query’s reasoning tree under an LLM critic [ 22 ] . In the area of formal reasoning and theorem proving: Optimizing-Lean-Agent [ 38 ] aims for math proving by routing over a binary action space using a logistic model over surface features of the failed attempts. This coarse continue-or-restart routing selects no goal and no proof strategy, and never conditions on decomposition structure or on other obligations. EconProver [ 21 ] also targets math proving, but on the training side: reinforcement learning teaches a single prover to switch reflective chain-of-thought off on easy theorems and to diversify its parallel samples, so they decide neither which obligation to work on nor which kind of action to buy. Danus [ 28 ] maintains a fact graph with transitive revocation for mathematical research agents but routes work to homogeneous general-purpose agents rather than specialists matched to goal types and makes no cost decision over that structure.
paragraphs.zh: 成本感知推理与智能体编排。 查询级路由器和级联结构根据孤立查询的表面特征选择模型 [6, 34]，而预算感知树搜索则在 LLM 批评者的监督下，对单个查询的推理树内的探索进行退火优化 [22]。 在形式化推理和定理证明领域：Optimizing-Lean-Agent [38] 旨在通过基于失败尝试表面特征的逻辑斯谛模型，在二元动作空间中进行路由，从而实现数学证明。 这种粗略的“继续或重启”路由既不选择目标，也不选择证明策略，且绝不会基于分解结构或其他约束条件做出决策。 EconProver [21] 同样针对数学证明，但侧重于训练环节：强化学习会教导单个证明器在简单定理上关闭反思性思维链，并使其并行样本多样化，因此这些样本既不会决定要处理哪个约束条件，也不会决定购买哪种类型的动作。 Danus [28] 为数学研究智能体维护了一个具有传递撤销关系的实体图，但将任务分配给同质的通用型智能体，而非与目标类型匹配的专用智能体，且未在该结构上做出任何成本决策。

paragraphs.en: We formulate cost-efficient program proving as metalevel decision-making under cost . At each step, the prover must determine (1) which goals to work on next, and (2) what proving strategy and configuration to use. The first is structural and the latter one requires semantic reasoning and incur model cost. Importantly, cost is considered globally at the task level: an expensive action on one goal may reduce total cost, for example by producing a helper lemma reused by several others. We measure cost as monetary expenditure rather than token count, since different token types are priced differently.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将具有成本效益的程序证明问题表述为一种在成本约束下的元层决策问题。 在每个步骤中，证明器必须确定（1）接下来要处理哪些目标，以及（2）使用何种证明策略和配置。 前者是结构性的，而后者则需要语义推理并产生模型成本。 重要的是，成本是在任务层面上进行全局考虑的：对某个目标采取的高成本操作可能会降低总成本，例如通过生成一个被其他多个目标重用的辅助引理。 我们将成本衡量为货币支出而非令牌数量，因为不同类型的令牌价格不同。

paragraphs.en: Proof state and structural control. Given a fixed Lean environment Γ 0 \Gamma_{0} and target theorems L ⋆ = { ℓ 1 , … , ℓ n } L_{\star}=\{\ell_{1},\ldots,\ell_{n}\} , the prover maintains the two-level proof graph in Figure 2 . Within each declaration, an AND/OR hypergraph records verified proof steps and their resulting subgoals; across declarations, a dependency graph connects target and helper lemmas. Together, they preserve partial progress, expose reusable results, and track which work depends on provisional lemmas.
paragraphs.zh: 证明状态与结构控制。 给定一个固定的 Lean 环境 Γ₀ \Gamma_{0} 和目标定理 L⋆ = {ℓ₁, …, ℓₙ} L_{\star}=\{\ell_{1},\ldots,\ell_{n}\}，证明器维护图 2 中的两级证明图。 在每个声明内部，一个 AND/OR 超图记录了已验证的证明步骤及其产生的子目标；在不同声明之间，一个依赖图连接了目标引理和辅助引理。 它们共同保留了部分进展，揭示了可重用的结果，并追踪了哪些工作依赖于临时引理。

paragraphs.en: Guided by the metalevel analysis of Section 3.1 , CoCo-Prover is an agent framework built around one principle: LLM agents make the semantic decisions and dispatch the decisions to the specialist agents as shown in Figure 3 . CoCo-Prover maintains the two-level proof graph together with a shared memory of artifact status, failure records, and the realized resource ledger. A scheduler selects the frontier goals on AND nodes symbolically according to discussion in Section 3.1 . An agentic router reasons about the selected goals and dispatches them to one of four specialist action agents. Each action agent writes its verified transitions, diagnostics, and realized cost back to the graph and shared memory.
paragraphs.zh: 在 3.1 节的元层级分析指导下，CoCo-Prover 是一个围绕一项原则构建的智能体框架：LLM 智能体负责做出语义决策，并将这些决策分配给专业智能体，如第 3 图所示。 CoCo-Prover 维护着双层证明图，以及一个共享内存，其中记录了工件状态、失败记录以及已使用的资源账目。 调度器根据 3.1 节的讨论，以符号化的方式选择 AND 节点上的前沿目标。 智能体路由器会对所选目标进行推理，并将其分配给四个专业动作智能体中的某一个。 每个动作智能体都会将其已验证的转换、诊断信息以及实际消耗的成本写回证明图和共享内存。

paragraphs.en: Evidence-grounded agentic router. The scheduler hands the router the whole dependency-ready frontier of open AND nodes. The router first groups it using k k -means clustering as described in Section B.4 , so that semantically related goals are routed together. A static-analysis check then runs before any model call: a goal that is definition-nested is sent directly to Deterministic Automation. At each decision point it receives an evidence packet , instantiating ev ⁡ ( s , U ) \mathrm{ev}(s,U) : the selected Lean goals with their tactic states and relevant definitions, snapshots of earlier proof states, the dependent provisional lemmas, and the execution history with Lean diagnostics and counterexamples from the shared memory, together with its current routing rules. The router approximates the metalevel ordering of Equation 3 in the small- λ \lambda regime of Proposition A.1 . From this packet it returns ( G , o , θ , j ) (G,o,\theta,j) : the group G G of the goals it decides to spend on next, drawn from its own clustering of the frontier; a specialist option o o ; a configuration θ \theta which sets the invocation’s reasoning effort and working budget ( e.g. , the maximum number of refinement iterations); and the preliminary analysis j j it produces, so that the action agents can continue the reasoning from it. The routing rules are initialized with one priority, same provability, cheap-first : among the actions equally likely to leave every remaining root provable, take the one with the lowest total expected cost of finishing them all. Both terms are task-level rather than goal-level, which means the comparison is predicted over the whole remaining task. This explains why proposing a helper lemma can be the cheapest choice when several goals will use it, even though proving it once costs more than one direct proof. The initial rules are deliberately simple: a short natural-language description of each specialist including what kind of goal it suits together with the priority and a few worked routing examples. The rules then evolve : after observing an evidence packet and the outcome of its previous decision, the router may amend them. For instance, if the Proof Writer repeatedly fails on a kind of goal, the rules may evolve to increase reasoning effort or propose a shared helper lemma to decompose the goal.
paragraphs.zh: 基于证据的智能体路由器。 调度器将整个依赖就绪的开放 AND 节点前沿交给路由器。 路由器首先使用 B.4 节中描述的 k 均值聚类法对其进行分组，以便将语义相关的目标一同路由。 在任何模型调用之前，都会运行一次静态分析检查：定义嵌套的目标会直接发送到确定性自动化模块。 在每个决策点，它都会接收一个证据包，实例化 ev⁡(s,U)：即选定的 Lean 目标及其战术状态和相关的定义、早期证明状态的快照、依赖的临时引理，以及包含 Lean 诊断信息和反例的执行历史（来自共享内存），同时还包括当前的路由规则。 路由器在命题 A.1 的小 λ 区间内，对公式 3 中的元层级排序进行近似处理。 基于该证据包，它返回 (G, o, θ, j)：即决定接下来要处理的目標组 G（从前沿的自身聚类中选取）、一个专家选项 o、一个配置 θ（用于设置调用的推理努力和工作预算，例如最大细化迭代次数），以及它生成的初步分析 j，以便动作智能体能够据此继续推理。 路由规则初始时设置一个优先级：相同可证性、成本优先原则——在同样可能使所有剩余根节点保持可证的行动中，选择完成全部行动所需总期望成本最低的那个。 这两个术语都是任务层级而非目标层级的，这意味着比较是在整个剩余任务范围内进行的预测。 这解释了为何当多个目标会用到某个辅助引理时，提出该引理可能成为最便宜的选择，尽管一次性证明它的成本高于直接证明一次。 初始规则被刻意设计得非常简单：每个专家模块的简短自然语言描述（包括其适用的目标类型、优先级以及几个已执行的路由示例）。 随后规则会不断演化：在观察到证据包及其先前决策的结果后，路由器可能会对其进行修改。 例如，如果证明编写器反复无法处理某类目标，规则可能会演化为增加推理努力或提出共享的辅助引理来分解该目标。

paragraphs.en: Specialist agents. The four specialists exist to handle different kinds of proof goals. Deterministic Automation: this action doesn’t involve any model call. It extends Aesop [ 25 ] , a white-box rule-based proof search methods, which automatically tries different tactics in Lean to solve the current goal. Proof Writer: it’s an agent interacting with Lean checker. It first continue on the reasoning results from the router and then write formal Lean code under a iterative refinement budget from the router. When the budget is exhausted, it keeps the partial successful proof and update the proof graphs. Lemma Planner: it proposes typed helper lemmas with explicit root-relevant consumers. A candidate is added to the dependency graph only after it elaborates and preserves acyclicity, it is checked by both random testing and LLM-based structural checking. Its proof obligations enter the frontier as new open goals, and control returns to the router with analysis tags. Recovery Reviewer: it diagnoses why an attempt failed, distinguishing two cases. First, the goal may be unprovable : a wrong proof step or an incorrect helper lemma can leave a goal that is false, so the reviewer constructs concrete instances and evaluates them to look for a counterexample to disprove the goal. Second, the goal may be provable but on a hard path : the current route has grown expensive while a cheaper one likely exists, so the reviewer compares continuing with switching on the work each still requires: the expected remaining cost, revalidation included, and whether either route looks less likely to close at all. The judgment is the model’s rather than a certified optimality test, since a cheaper route can also be a less provable one. When it decides to recover, it backtracks to the best point in the proof graphs ( i.e. , the nearest state whose verified work does not depend on the failure) so only the invalidated work is discarded.
paragraphs.zh: 专业智能体。 这四位专业智能体的存在是为了处理不同类型的证明目标。 确定性自动化：此操作不涉及任何模型调用。 它扩展了 Aesop [ 25 ]，这是一种白盒规则 기반 的证明搜索方法，能够自动尝试 Lean 中的不同策略以解决当前目标。 证明编写器：这是一个与 Lean 检查器交互的智能体。 它首先继续处理路由器提供的推理结果，然后在路由器分配的迭代优化预算下编写正式的 Lean 代码。 当预算用尽时，它会保留部分成功的证明，并更新证明图。 引理规划器：它会提出带有明确根相关消费者的类型化辅助引理。 一个候选项只有在经过详细展开并保持无环性之后才会被添加到依赖图中，并且会同时通过随机测试和基于 LLM 的结构检查进行验证。 其证明义务会以新开放目标的形式进入前沿，并将带有分析标签的控制权返回给路由器。 恢复审查员：它会诊断尝试失败的原因，并区分两种情况。 首先，该目标可能无法被证明：错误的证明步骤或不正确的辅助引理可能导致一个为假的目标，因此审查员会构建具体实例并进行评估，以寻找反例来推翻该目标。 其次，该目标可能可以被证明，但路径较难：当前路线的成本已经很高，而很可能存在更便宜的路线，因此审查员会比较继续当前路线与切换路线各自仍需的工作量：包括预期剩余成本和重新验证在内的成本，以及两条路线中哪一条更有可能成功闭合。 这一判断来自模型本身，而非经过认证的优化性测试，因为更便宜的路线也可能更难被证明。 当决定恢复时，它会回溯到证明图中的最佳节点（即最近的、其已验证工作不依赖于失败状态的状态），因此只有被无效化的工作会被丢弃。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we first evaluate CoCo-Prover on the performance of solve rate, cost and success-vs-cost frontier under a budget sweep. paragraphs.en: Benchmarks. We evaluate on five Lean 4 program verification benchmarks. Three are function-level: CLEVER [ 43 ] , VERINA [ 54 ] , and AlgoVeri [ 57 ] , which provide function-level verifiable code generation problems. Two are repository-level, where obligations are derived from upstream code repositories. NTP4VC [ 51 ] focuses on verification conditions, generated from C and Why3 programs, and released in Lean 4, Rocq, and Isabelle, where we use the Lean 4 track. Vero [ 53 ] is a repository-level verifiable code generation benchmark, where we use proof-only tasks. The target theorems are constructed as follows. VERINA and Vero ship both ground-truth specifications and ground-truth implementations, which we use the formed theorem tasks directly. CLEVER and AlgoVeri provide ground-truth specifications but no ground-truth implementations, so we generate each implementation with GPT-5.6-Sol at high reasoning effort and manually check its correctness against the specification before any prover runs; the checked implementations are then fixed and shared by all methods. NTP4VC’s theorems are already well-formed verification conditions but it’s a large benchmark so we only use the first 300 tasks in alphabetical order. In every case the theorem statements are fixed inputs and code or specification synthesis is never a part of the measured task.
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试。 我们在五个 Lean 4 程序验证基准测试上进行评估。 其中三个是函数级基准测试：CLEVER [ 43 ]、VERINA [ 54 ] 和 AlgoVeri [ 57 ]，它们提供了函数级的可验证代码生成问题。 另外两个是仓库级基准测试，其约束条件源自上游代码仓库。 NTP4VC [ 51 ] 专注于验证条件，这些条件由 C 和 Why3 程序生成，并在 Lean 4、Rocq 和 Isabelle 中发布，我们使用其中的 Lean 4 版本。 Vero [ 53 ] 是一个仓库级的可验证代码生成基准测试，我们仅使用其中的纯证明任务。 目标定理的构建方式如下。 VERINA 和 Vero 同时提供了真实规格和真实实现，我们可以直接使用它们构成的定理任务。 CLEVER 和 AlgoVeri 提供了真实规格但未提供真实实现，因此我们使用 GPT-5.6-Sol 在高推理努力下生成每个实现，并在任何证明器运行前手动检查其相对于规格的正确性；经过检查的实现随后会被固定并由所有方法共享。 NTP4VC 的定理已经是结构良好的验证条件，但由于这是一个大型基准测试，我们仅使用按字母顺序排列的前 300 个任务。 在所有情况下，定理陈述都是固定的输入，代码或规格的合成从未被纳入所测量的任务中。

paragraphs.en: Baselines. We compare against three baseline families under identical backbones, providers, and caps. We use three frontier models: Gemini-3.5-Flash, GPT-5.6-Terra, and DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Ax-Prover-Base [ 37 ] is a minimal iterative agent—propose a Lean proof, compile, review, and retry with a memory of recent failures and library search—representative of refinement agents and reported to be strongly cost-effective relative to repeated sampling. Humanize [ 17 ] is an open-source state-of-the-art agentic Lean 4 prover based on coding agents like Codex [ 35 ] and Claude Code [ 3 ] , which achieves 100% solve rate on PutnamBench [ 46 ] . Coding agents pair each backbone with its official general-purpose agent interface, equipped with tooling ( i.e., Lean toolchains, retrieval)—Codex for GPT model, Gemini CLI [ 12 ] for Gemini model, and DeepSeek Harness [ 10 ] for DeepSeek model. Ax-Prover-Base and Humanize prove one self-contained theorem per episode and do not operate over repository-scale dependency structure, so the repository-level comparison includes only the coding agents ( Table 1 ). We do not compare against other open-source provers such as Hilbert [ 48 ] , Goedel-Code-Prover [ 23 ] , WybeCoder [ 13 ] , and P 3 \mathrm{P}^{3} [ 24 ] because each is designed for a different setting, and Section C.1 gives the reason for each.
paragraphs.zh: 基线模型。 我们在相同的骨干模型、提供商和限制条件下，与三个基线模型家族进行了比较。 我们使用了三种前沿模型：Gemini-3.5-Flash、GPT-5.6-Terra 和 DeepSeek-V4-Flash。 Ax-Prover-Base [ 37 ] 是一个最小化的迭代智能体——它会提出一个 Lean 证明，进行编译、审查，并基于近期失败的记忆和库搜索进行重试——它代表了精炼型智能体，并且据报告在与重复采样相比时具有显著的成本效益。 Humanize [ 17 ] 是一个开源的、基于 Codex [ 35 ] 和 Claude Code [ 3 ] 等编码智能体的先进 Lean 4 证明器，它在 PutnamBench [ 46 ] 上实现了 100% 的解决率。 编码智能体将每个骨干模型与其官方的通用智能体接口配对，并配备了相关工具（即 Lean 工具链和检索功能）——GPT 模型使用 Codex，Gemini 模型使用 Gemini CLI [ 12 ]，DeepSeek 模型使用 DeepSeek Harness [ 10 ]。 Ax-Prover-Base 和 Humanize 每个回合仅证明一个自包含的定理，并且不会在仓库级别的依赖结构上运行，因此仓库级别的比较仅包括编码智能体（表 1）。 我们没有与其他开源证明器进行比较，例如 Hilbert [ 48 ]、Goedel-Code-Prover [ 23 ]、WybeCoder [ 13 ] 和 P 3 \mathrm{P}^{3} [ 24 ]，因为每个模型都是为不同的场景设计的，第 C.1 节说明了各自的理由。

paragraphs.en: Solve rates. As shown in Table 1 , no baseline exceeds CoCo-Prover’s solve rate in any benchmark–LLM pair. On function-level benchmarks with a frontier LLM there is little headroom: Humanize, the strongest baseline, already proves almost every CLEVER and VERINA problem, and CoCo-Prover closes the remainder to 100% on CLEVER and VERINA; on AlgoVeri with Gemini-3.5-Flash the two tie. This also reflects CoCo-Prover’s advantage on different LLMs and its scalability. The second is repository scale: on Vero the coding agents solve at most 7.0% of tasks, against up to 60.5% for CoCo-Prover. Vero’s obligations are spread across a repository and share definitions and helper lemmas, so a prover that treats all obligations in a single context will be overwhelmed, whereas CoCo-Prover uses proof graphs and agent orchestration to handle them effectively.
paragraphs.zh: 解决率。 如表 1 所示，在任何基准-LLM 组合中，都没有基线模型能超过 CoCo-Prover 的解决率。 在使用前沿 LLM 的函数级基准测试中，提升空间很小：最强基线模型 Humanize 已经能证明几乎所有 CLEVER 和 VERINA 问题，而 CoCo-Prover 在 CLEVER 和 VERINA 上则将剩余问题的解决率提升至 100%；而在使用 Gemini-3.5-Flash 的 AlgoVeri 测试中，两者表现持平。 这也反映了 CoCo-Prover 在不同 LLM 上的优势及其可扩展性。 第二个因素是代码库规模：在 Vero 上，编码智能体最多只能解决 7.0% 的任务，而 CoCo-Prover 的解决率最高可达 60.5%。 Vero 的义务分布在整个代码库中，并共享定义和辅助引理，因此，若证明器将所有义务置于单一上下文中处理，将会不堪重负；而 CoCo-Prover 则通过证明图和智能体协调机制有效应对这些义务。

sents.zh: 如表 1 所示，在任何基准-LLM 组合中，都没有基线模型能超过 CoCo-Prover 的解决率。

sents.zh: 在使用前沿 LLM 的函数级基准测试中，提升空间很小：最强基线模型 Humanize 已经能证明几乎所有 CLEVER 和 VERINA 问题，而 CoCo-Prover 在 CLEVER 和 VERINA 上则将剩余问题的解决率提升至 100%；而在使用 Gemini-3.5-Flash 的 AlgoVeri 测试中，两者表现持平。

sents.en: This also reflects CoCo-Prover’s advantage on different LLMs and its scalability.
sents.zh: 这也反映了 CoCo-Prover 在不同 LLM 上的优势及其可扩展性。

sents.en: The second is repository scale: on Vero the coding agents solve at most 7.0% of tasks, against up to 60.5% for CoCo-Prover.
sents.zh: 第二个因素是代码库规模：在 Vero 上，编码智能体最多只能解决 7.0% 的任务，而 CoCo-Prover 的解决率最高可达 60.5%。

sents.en: Vero’s obligations are spread across a repository and share definitions and helper lemmas, so a prover that treats all obligations in a single context will be overwhelmed, whereas CoCo-Prover uses proof graphs and agent orchestration to handle them effectively.
sents.zh: Vero 的义务分布在整个代码库中，并共享定义和辅助引理，因此，若证明器将所有义务置于单一上下文中处理，将会不堪重负；而 CoCo-Prover 则通过证明图和智能体协调机制有效应对这些义务。

paragraphs.en: Cost at matched success. We compare cost against one baseline at a time, and only on the problems that this baseline and CoCo-Prover both solve. Costs on unsolved problems are not comparable: a method that gives up early, or that reward-hacks a hard problem such as closing it with an axiom, weakening or rewriting the theorem statement ( i.e. , the behavior we observe most often in the coding agents) spends little precisely where an honest proof is expensive, so counting those runs would reward failure. On the commonly solved problems, CoCo-Prover is cheaper than every baseline in all nine function-level benchmark–LLM pairs ( Table 2 ). The cost saving is largest against Ax-Prover-Base (up to 85.7%), which re-samples a whole proof after each failure, and against every baseline under DeepSeek-V4-Flash, where failures are most frequent. It is smallest against Humanize (from 1.3% to 30.9% under GPT-5.6-Terra and Gemini-3.5-Flash), the strongest baseline, since for most easy problems, Humanize and the basic coding agents can simply propose and refine proofs so that our gain is small. The one case where a baseline is cheaper is Vero with GPT-5.6-Terra, where Codex solves a single task that CoCo-Prover also solves. This is because this is only one task problem which only has a few easy obligations so it doesn’t weaken CoCo-Prover’s advantage. The two settings therefore differ in what CoCo-Prover buys. On isolated function-level obligations, it principally reduces proof cost. On repository-level verification, persistent proof structure can additionally change what is practically provable: on Vero, CoCo-Prover solves up to 26 of 43 tasks while the coding agents solve at most three, which is also why too few commonly solved tasks remain there for a meaningful cost comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 匹配成功时的成本。 我们每次仅将成本与一个基线方法进行比较，且仅限于该基线方法与 CoCo-Prover 都能解决的问题。 未解决问题上的成本不可比较：一种方法若过早放弃，或通过奖励机制“作弊”解决难题（例如用公理闭合问题、弱化或重写定理陈述——即我们在编码智能体中最常观察到的行为），则恰恰在诚实证明代价高昂之处消耗极少的资源，因此统计这类运行会奖励失败。 在普遍能解决的问题上，CoCo-Prover 在所有九个函数级基准–LLM 组合中（表 2）都比每个基线方法更便宜。 与 Ax-Prover-Base 相比，成本节省幅度最大（高达 85.7%），因为后者每次失败后都会重新采样整个证明；与 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 下的所有基线方法相比，成本节省也较大，因为该方法中失败最为频繁。 与 Humanize 相比，成本节省幅度最小（在 GPT-5.6-Terra 和 Gemini-3.5-Flash 下分别为 1.3% 至 30.9%），因为 Humanize 是最强的基线方法；对于大多数简单问题，Humanize 和基本编码智能体可以直接提出并完善证明，因此我们的收益很小。 唯一一种基线方法更便宜的情况是 Vero 搭配 GPT-5.6-Terra，此时 Codex 解决了一个 CoCo-Prover 也能解决的单一任务。 这是因为这只是一个单一任务问题，且仅有少数简单要求，因此并未削弱 CoCo-Prover 的优势。 因此，这两种设置中 CoCo-Prover 所获得的优势有所不同。 在孤立的函数级任务上，它主要降低了证明成本。 在仓库级验证中，稳定的证明结构还可能改变实际可证明的内容：在 Vero 中，CoCo-Prover 解决了 43 个任务中的多达 26 个，而编码智能体最多只解决了三个；这也是为何此处剩余能普遍解决的任务太少，无法进行有意义的成本比较。

paragraphs.en: Success–cost frontier under a budget sweep. Figure 4 asks a complementary question to Table 2 : sweeping the per-problem cap from $0 to the $30 of the main evaluation, how many problems does each method solve? For each LLM we sum the problems solved over the three function-level benchmarks (CLEVER, VERINA, and AlgoVeri) at every budget, so each curve is one method’s success–cost frontier. As shown in Figure 4 , CoCo-Prover achieves the highest final solve count under all three backbones and leads over much of the evaluated budget range. Moreover, the baselines flatten early. Under GPT-5.6-Terra, Codex and Ax-Prover-Base gain relatively few additional solves beyond roughly $5 per problem, while CoCo-Prover reaches 419. This is because the extra money buys more of the same discarded work.
paragraphs.zh: 预算扫描下的成功–成本前沿。 图 4 提出了一个与表 2 互补的问题：当每道题目的预算上限从 0 美元逐步增加到主评估中使用的 30 美元时，每种方法能解决多少问题？ 对于每个 LLM，我们在每个预算水平上统计其在三个函数级基准测试（CLEVER、VERINA 和 AlgoVeri）中解决的问题总数，因此每条曲线代表一种方法的成功–成本前沿。 如图 4 所示，CoCo-Prover 在所有三种基础模型下都实现了最高的最终解题数量，并在大部分评估的预算范围内保持领先。 此外，基线方法的解题数量很早就趋于平缓。 在使用 GPT-5.6-Terra 时，Codex 和 Ax-Prover-Base 在每道题预算达到约 5 美元后，新增的解题数量相对较少，而 CoCo-Prover 则达到了 419 题。 这是因为额外的资金只是购买了更多相同的被舍弃的工作。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we conduct some ablation studies to understand the contribution of each component in CoCo-Prover. Since rerunning all five benchmarks for every variant is too expensive, we use a fixed subset: 10 problems (randomly chosen, which span difficulty levels from easy to hard) from each of CLEVER, VERINA, and AlgoVeri, 30 in total.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们进行了一些消融研究，以理解 CoCo-Prover 中每个组件的贡献。 由于为每种变体重新运行全部五个基准测试的成本过高，我们使用一个固定的子集：从 CLEVER、VERINA 和 AlgoVeri 中各选取 10 个问题（随机选择，涵盖从简单到困难的难度级别），总计 30 个。

sents.en: In this section, we conduct some ablation studies to understand the contribution of each component in CoCo-Prover.
sents.zh: 在本节中，我们进行了一些消融研究，以理解 CoCo-Prover 中每个组件的贡献。

sents.en: Since rerunning all five benchmarks for every variant is too expensive, we use a fixed subset: 10 problems (randomly chosen, which span difficulty levels from easy to hard) from each of CLEVER, VERINA, and AlgoVeri, 30 in total.
sents.zh: 由于为每种变体重新运行全部五个基准测试的成本过高，我们使用一个固定的子集：从 CLEVER、VERINA 和 AlgoVeri 中各选取 10 个问题（随机选择，涵盖从简单到困难的难度级别），总计 30 个。

paragraphs.en: We first conduct a run-to-run variance analysis to understand the stability of CoCo-Prover since model outputs are stochastic. We firstly run the complete CoCo-Prover three times with Gemini-3.5-Flash on 3 function-level benchmarks and then we run the complete CoCo-Prover three times with each backbone LLM on these 30 problems and details are shown in Section C.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 由于模型输出具有随机性，我们首先进行了一次运行间方差分析，以了解 CoCo-Prover 的稳定性。 我们首先使用 Gemini-3.5-Flash 在 3 个函数级基准测试上完整运行了 CoCo-Prover 三次，然后使用每个基础 LLM 在这 30 个问题上再次完整运行 CoCo-Prover 三次，详细信息见 C.4 节。

paragraphs.en: Component ablation. To attribute the gains to individual components, we disable one component at a time and rerun CoCo-Prover on the 30 problems with Gemini-3.5-Flash. Table 3 compares each variant against the complete system, whose cost is the mean of its three Gemini-3.5-Flash runs in Table 7 . CoCo-Prover w/o Router removes adaptive action choice: Deterministic Automation still runs first on every scheduled goal, and the action agents then follow one fixed order over the same two-level graph. Total cost rises by 39.9% and one VERINA problem is no longer solved. This is because the fixed routine purchases more unnecessary action invocations. CoCo-Prover w/o Lemma Planner removes shared-helper discovery, so every goal must be proved in isolation. It is the costliest variant, at 41.6% above the complete system, and it solves the fewest problems (27 of 30), losing two on VERINA and one on AlgoVeri. This mirrors the failure the case study isolates in the baselines ( Appendix D ): without lemma proposal, a missing fact cannot become a separately provable subgoal, so it is re-derived inside monolithic attempts instead of proved once and reused. CoCo-Prover w/o Automation removes the automation pass. Its effect is smaller: cost rises by 11.5% on CLEVER and 12.4% on VERINA, where many goals close mechanically, but falls by 5.8% on AlgoVeri, whose algorithmic goals rarely close by automation and frequent automation will split amonolithic goal into multiple meaningless subgoals, which increases cost. Overall, the component ablation study supports the theoretical analysis and system design of CoCo-Prover.
paragraphs.zh: 组件消融分析。 为将性能提升归因于各个组件，我们每次禁用一个组件，并使用 Gemini-3.5-Flash 在 30 个问题上重新运行 CoCo-Prover。 表 3 将每个变体与完整系统进行了比较，其中完整系统的成本是其在表 7 中三次 Gemini-3.5-Flash 运行的平均值。 CoCo-Prover w/o Router 移除了自适应动作选择：确定性自动化仍会首先在每个预定目标上运行，随后动作智能体将按固定顺序在相同的两级图上执行操作。 总成本上升了 39.9%，且有一个 VERINA 问题无法再被解决。 这是因为固定流程会购买更多不必要的动作调用。 CoCo-Prover w/o Lemma Planner 移除了共享辅助发现机制，因此每个目标都必须独立证明。 这是成本最高的变体，比完整系统高出 41.6%，且解决的问题数量最少（30 个中的 27 个），在 VERINA 上损失两个问题，在 AlgoVeri 上损失一个。 这与案例研究在基线方法中识别出的失败情况一致（附录 D）：在没有引理提议的情况下，缺失的事实无法成为可单独证明的子目标，因此只能在整体尝试中被重新推导，而不是先被证明一次并重复使用。 CoCo-Prover w/o Automation 移除了自动化阶段。 其影响较小：在 CLEVER 上成本上升 11.5%，在 VERINA 上上升 12.4%（这两个系统中许多目标可通过机械方式完成），但在 AlgoVeri 上则下降了 5.8%（该系统的算法目标很少通过自动化完成，而频繁的自动化会将一个整体目标拆分为多个无意义的子目标，从而增加成本）。 总体而言，组件消融研究支持了 CoCo-Prover 的理论分析和系统设计。

paragraphs.en: We presented CoCo-Prover, an agent-orchestration framework for cost-efficient theorem proving in program verification with Lean 4. CoCo-Prover formalizes proving as metalevel decision-making under cost, grounded on two-level proof graphs. A symbolic scheduler selects every dependency-ready goal, and an evidence-grounded router groups them and purchases actions from four bounded specialist agents with Lean as the sole proof authority. Across five Lean program verification benchmarks and three backbones, CoCo-Prover achieves highest solve rate in any setting, and it reduces cost on commonly solved problems by up to 30.9% against the strongest baseline, Humanize. Ablations also demonstrates the advantages of the system design with the shared-lemma discovery and adaptive routing.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 CoCo-Prover，这是一个智能体协调框架，用于在 Lean 4 中实现成本高效的定理证明。 CoCo-Prover 将证明过程形式化为基于双层证明图的成本驱动元层决策问题。 一个符号调度器会选择每个依赖关系已就绪的目标，而一个基于证据的路由器则对这些目标进行分组，并从四个具有资源限制的专家智能体中购买操作，其中 Lean 是唯一的证明权威。 在五个 Lean 程序验证基准测试和三种基础架构中，CoCo-Prover 在所有场景下都实现了最高的解决率，并且在常见可解决的问题上，其成本相比最强的基线方法 Humanize 最多降低了 30.9%。 消融实验也证明了该系统设计中共享引理发现和自适应路由的优势。

sents.en: CoCo-Prover formalizes proving as metalevel decision-making under cost, grounded on two-level proof graphs.

sents.en: Across five Lean program verification benchmarks and three backbones, CoCo-Prover achieves highest solve rate in any setting, and it reduces cost on commonly solved problems by up to 30.9% against the strongest baseline, Humanize.

paragraphs.en: Section A.1 states the metalevel process of Section 3.1 in full, and Section A.2 proves Theorem 1 and Corollary 2. Section A.1 also names the operating point our protocol targets and shows that, in a finite abstraction of the process, the induced ordering is constant there ( Propositions A.1 and A.2 ); that the deployment realizes the abstraction is assumed, not shown. Sections A.3 , A.4 , A.5 , A.6 and A.7 establish structural properties of the two-level representation: it preserves reachability, graph information weakly—and on some instances strictly—raises the attainable value, the hard filters preserve the optimal value under their stated assumptions, sharing a helper can save a factor K K , and returned proofs are kernel-sound.
paragraphs.zh: A.1 节完整阐述了第 3.1 节的元层级过程，而 A.2 节则证明了定理 1 和推论 2。 A.1 节还指出了我们协议所针对的运行点，并表明在该过程的有限抽象中，由此导出的序关系是恒定的（命题 A.1 和 A.2）；至于部署是否实现了该抽象，此处仅作假设，未加证明。 A.3、A.4、A.5、A.6 和 A.7 节确立了这种双层表示的结构特性：它能保持可达性，对图信息仅保持弱等价性——在某些实例中甚至保持严格等价性；还能提升可达值；硬性过滤器在其既定假设下能保持最优值；共享辅助智能体可节省 K 倍的成本；且返回的证明具有核心正确性。

paragraphs.en: Within this abstraction the two initial routing rules are statements about one ordering rather than heuristics attached to a particular λ \lambda . A working budget θ \theta is an operational constraint: once it is exhausted, continuing on the same goal is simply outside 𝒞 ⁡ ( s , U ) \mathcal{C}(s,U) , and the controller returns to the router, which may re-decide. Whether this is also value-preserving is a comparison of whole continuations: writing h ret h_{\mathrm{ret}} for the routing overhead, returning dominates continuing exactly when p ret − λ ⁡ ( h ret + 𝔼 ⁡ [ C ret ] ) ≥ p cont − λ ​ 𝔼 ​ [ C cont ] p_{\mathrm{ret}}-\lambda\bigl(h_{\mathrm{ret}}+\mathbb{E}[C_{\mathrm{ret}}]\bigr)\geq p_{\mathrm{cont}}-\lambda\,\mathbb{E}[C_{\mathrm{cont}}] . Retaining the partial proof and the router’s analysis, so that work is resumed rather than redone, keeps p ret p_{\mathrm{ret}} and 𝔼 ⁡ [ C ret ] \mathbb{E}[C_{\mathrm{ret}}] close to their continuing counterparts, but it does not by itself establish the inequality: if one further refinement would have closed the goal for 1 1 , a return costing 0.2 0.2 that resumes the same refinement totals 1.2 1.2 . We therefore treat the bounded contract as a restriction of the action space, justified operationally by retention, and do not claim it is free.
paragraphs.zh: 在此抽象框架中，两条初始的路由规则是关于某种排序的陈述，而非与特定 λ \lambda 相关的启发式方法。 可用预算 θ \theta 是一项运行约束：一旦用尽，继续追求同一目标将完全超出 𝒞 ⁡ ( s , U ) \mathcal{C}(s,U) ，控制器便会返回路由器，后者可能会重新做出决策。 这是否同时保持价值，需要比较完整的后续过程：若用 h ret h_{\mathrm{ret}} 表示路由开销，则当且仅当 p ret − λ ⁡ ( h ret + 𝔼 ⁡ [ C ret ] ) ≥ p cont − λ ​ 𝔼 ​ [ C cont ] p_{\mathrm{ret}}-\lambda\bigl(h_{\mathrm{ret}}+\mathbb{E}[C_{\mathrm{ret}}]\bigr)\geq p_{\mathrm{cont}}-\lambda\,\mathbb{E}[C_{\mathrm{cont}}] 时，返回优于继续执行。 保留部分证明和路由器的分析，从而恢复工作而非重复劳动，可使 p ret p_{\mathrm{ret}} 和 𝔼 ⁡ [ C ret ] \mathbb{E}[C_{\mathrm{ret}}] 保持与继续执行时的对应值相近，但这本身并未确立该不等式：若进一步细化本可完成目标 1 1 ，则成本为 0.2 0.2 的返回操作加上恢复相同细化的总成本将达到 1.2 1.2 。 因此，我们将有界合同视为对动作空间的限制，其合理性源于保留机制的实际运行效果，但我们并不声称它是免费的。

paragraphs.en: Theorem 1 is the performance-difference identity of reinforcement learning [ 19 ] , specialized to purchased computations with an explicit charge for deliberation. What it fixes is the target of the design: a router is worthwhile precisely to the extent that its choices lose less continuation value than a fixed routine’s, net of its own inference cost.
paragraphs.zh: 定理 1 是强化学习中的性能差异恒等式 [ 19 ]，专门针对带有明确推理费用的购买计算。 它确定的是设计的目标：一个路由器是否值得采用，完全取决于其选择所损失的延续价值是否低于固定流程的选择，且需扣除其自身的推理成本。

paragraphs.en: CoCo-Prover shrinks 𝒞 ⁡ ( s , U ) \mathcal{C}(s,U) with two hard filters. The first is the no identical deterministic repetition clause of Guards ( Algorithm 1 ), which the Deterministic Automation branch supports by caching a no-progress result against reruns on an unchanged state. The second is the subtraction of RootDisc ​ ( 𝒟 t ) \textsc{RootDisc}(\mathcal{D}_{t}) from the frontier, together with the Lemma Planner’s requirement that a proposed helper name root-relevant consumers ( Section 3.2 ), so that work with no path to a root is never scheduled. This subsection asks when discarding those options is free, that is, when it leaves V λ ∗ ​ ( s ) V^{*}_{\lambda}(s) unchanged. Both rely on the same proviso, which we state as erasability : the filtered computation can be deleted from any trajectory that contains it, leaving the subsequent admissible actions, their output laws and prices, the scheduling, and the terminal behavior unchanged, so in particular V λ ∗ ​ ( s ′ ) = V λ ∗ ​ ( s ) V^{*}_{\lambda}(s^{\prime})=V^{*}_{\lambda}(s) for its successor s ′ s^{\prime} . Equality of the optimal value alone is not enough. A free computation with δ λ = 0 \delta_{\lambda}=0 can be the only route to the optimal continuation, which is a free step that sets a flag on which a cheaper proof action depends ties with the optimum, yet deleting it strictly lowers the value. Thus, the deletion argument needs the stronger, behavioral condition.
paragraphs.zh: CoCo-Prover 通过两个硬性过滤器来收缩 𝒞⁡(s,U) \mathcal{C}(s,U)。 第一个是 Guards（算法 1）中禁止相同确定性重复的条款，确定性自动化分支通过缓存无进展结果来支持该条款，以防止在状态未改变时重复执行。 第二个是从前沿中减去 RootDisc(𝒟t) \textsc{RootDisc}(\mathcal{D}_{t})，同时 Lemma Planner 要求提议的辅助名称必须与根相关的消费者（第 3.2 节），因此任何没有通往根的路径的工作都不会被安排。 本小节探讨在何种情况下丢弃这些选项是免费的，也就是说，在何种情况下它不会改变 Vλ∗(s) V^{*}_{\lambda}(s)。 两者都依赖同一项前提条件，我们将其表述为“可擦除性”：经过过滤的计算可以从任何包含它的轨迹中删除，而后续的可允许动作、其输出法则和价格、调度以及终端行为均保持不变，因此特别地，对于其后继状态 s′，有 Vλ∗(s′)=Vλ∗(s) V^{*}_{\lambda}(s^{\prime})=V^{*}_{\lambda}(s)。 仅最优值相等是不够的。 一个满足 δλ=0 \delta_{\lambda}=0 的免费计算可能是通往最优延续的唯一路径，即一个免费步骤设置了一个标志，而某个更便宜的证明动作依赖于该标志以达到最优结果，但删除它却会严格降低价值。 因此，删除论证需要更强、更具行为性的条件。

paragraphs.zh: 假设以下四点成立：(i) 已声明的 Lean 环境 Γ₀ 被接受；(ii) CoCo-Prover 仅在 Lean 接受其证明后才会推广所生成的引理；(iii) 根节点 ℓ ∈ L⋆ 的每个生成依赖都是稳定的；以及 (iv) 不会出现任何禁止的占位符或未批准的公理。 如果 CoCo-Prover 返回了 ℓ 的一个稳定证明，那么 Γ₀ ⊢ ℓ。

paragraphs.en: This subsection gives the full definition of the two-level proof graphs summarized in Section 3.1 and drawn in Figure 2 .

paragraphs.en: Inter-lemma dependency graph. Across declarations, the lemma-dependency graph 𝒟 = ( L , E 𝒟 ) \mathcal{D}=(L,E_{\mathcal{D}}) is a directed acyclic graph that carries an edge u → v u\rightarrow v whenever the current proof or plan for v v uses helper lemma u u . The targets L ⋆ ⊆ L L_{\star}\subseteq L are its roots, so helper-lemma work is useful only through a dependency path to some root.
paragraphs.zh: 词项间依赖图。 在所有声明中，词项依赖图 𝒟 = ( L , E 𝒟 ) \mathcal{D}=(L,E_{\mathcal{D}}) 是一个有向无环图，每当当前对 v v 的证明或计划使用辅助词项 u u 时，图中就存在一条边 u → v u\rightarrow v。 目标集合 L ⋆ ⊆ L L_{\star}\subseteq L 是该图的根节点，因此辅助词项的工作只有通过到某个根节点的依赖路径才有用。

paragraphs.en: Intra-lemma AND/OR hypergraph. Within every target theorem ℓ ⋆ , i ∈ L ⋆ \ell_{\star,i}\in L_{\star} or generated helper lemma ℓ \ell , a lazily constructed AND/OR proof hypergraph ℋ ℓ = ( A ℓ , O ℓ , E ℓ ) \mathcal{H}_{\ell}=(A_{\ell},O_{\ell},E_{\ell}) is a tree rooted at the lemma’s initial goal. AND nodes A ℓ A_{\ell} are normalized Lean goal states, all of whose subgoals must be proved; OR nodes O ℓ O_{\ell} are candidate proof steps (a tactic or tactic sequence), siblings being alternatives for the same goal. Executing a step o o attaches the verified hyperedge e = ( o , { g 1 , … , g k } ) ∈ E ℓ e=(o,\{g_{1},\ldots,g_{k}\})\in E_{\ell} recording exactly the subgoals Lean returns, with k = 0 k=0 when the step closes its goal. A goal keeps at most one valid alternative at a time; an alternative discarded by the Recovery Reviewer ( Section 3.2 ) is retained as failure evidence while a new one is added.
paragraphs.zh: 词素内 AND/OR 超图。 在每个目标定理 ℓ ⋆ 中，对于 i ∈ L ⋆ \ell_{\star,i}\in L_{\star} 或生成的辅助引理 ℓ \ell，存在一个懒式构造的 AND/OR 证明超图 ℋ ℓ = ( A ℓ , O ℓ , E ℓ ) \mathcal{H}_{\ell}=(A_{\ell},O_{\ell},E_{\ell})，它是一个以引理初始目标为根节点的树。 AND 节点 A ℓ A_{\ell} 是归一化的 Lean 目标状态，其所有子目标都必须被证明；OR 节点 O ℓ O_{\ell} 是候选的证明步骤（一个战术或战术序列），其中兄弟节点代表同一目标的不同替代方案。 执行一个步骤 o 会附加已验证的超边 e = ( o , { g 1 , … , g k } ) ∈ E ℓ e=(o,\{g_{1},\ldots,g_{k}\})\in E_{\ell}，该超边精确记录了 Lean 返回的子目标；当该步骤关闭其目标时，k = 0 k=0。 一个目标每次最多保留一个有效的替代方案；被恢复审查员（第 3.2 节）丢弃的替代方案会被保留作为失败证据，同时会添加一个新的替代方案。

paragraphs.en: Artifact status. Each artifact is labeled open , provisional , conditionally solved , stable , or rejected , and a goal with no admissible action is blocked . Only a Lean-accepted declaration whose generated dependencies are stable can itself become stable, and conditional plans guide search but never certify a root.
paragraphs.zh: 工件状态。 每个工件都会被标记为“开放”、“临时”、“有条件解决”、“稳定”或“被拒绝”，而没有可行动作的目标则会被阻塞。 只有其生成的依赖关系被 Lean 接受的声明本身才能变为稳定，而条件计划仅用于指导搜索，绝不会认证任何根节点。

paragraphs.en: Nonlocal effects. This structure makes the two nonlocal effects of our setting explicit: one stable helper lemma serving several consumers, and a failed provisional helper lemma invalidating exactly its conditional descendants, so a failure rolls back to the nearest safe point instead of discarding whole attempts.
paragraphs.zh: 非局部效应。 这种结构明确揭示了我们所设情境中的两种非局部效应：一种是一个稳定的辅助引理为多个消费者服务；另一种是一个失败的临时辅助引理会使其条件后项完全失效，因此失败只会回滚到最近的安全点，而不是丢弃整个尝试过程。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 1 states the complete control loop of CoCo-Prover ( Section 3.2 ): each epoch builds the frontier symbolically, lets the router group it and pick one group, purchases one routed action, and writes its verified result back, with initialization, evidence construction, decision validation, the two write-back paths, admissibility failure, and termination made explicit.
paragraphs.zh: 算法 1 描述了 CoCo-Prover（第 3.2 节）的完整控制循环：每个周期都以符号方式构建前沿，让路由器对其进行分组并选择一个组，购买一个已路由的动作，并将验证后的结果写回；其中初始化、证据构建、决策验证、两种写回路径、可接受性失败以及终止过程均被明确说明。

paragraphs.en: The operators are as follows. Propagate closes artifact status over 𝒟 t \mathcal{D}_{t} : a stabilized helper lemma releases its consumers, a rejected or changed provisional artifact marks its conditional descendants invalidated. Open ​ ( 𝔊 t ) \textsc{Open}(\mathfrak{G}_{t}) is the set of open AND nodes; Prereq ​ ( g ) \textsc{Prereq}(g) is the set of active prerequisites in 𝒟 t \mathcal{D}_{t} ; Elaborated ​ ( σ t ) \textsc{Elaborated}(\sigma_{t}) is the set of declarations with an elaborated statement, stable or provisional, against which a proof can be constructed, while Stable ​ ( σ t ) \textsc{Stable}(\sigma_{t}) is the smaller set that may be promoted; RootDisc ​ ( 𝒟 t ) \textsc{RootDisc}(\mathcal{D}_{t}) is the set of lemmas with no dependency path to a root, which are discarded; Sched is the structural stage of Equation 1 : it maintains the frontier and hands all of it to the agentic router, U t = ℱ t U_{t}=\mathcal{F}_{t} . Grouping is the router’s: Cluster partitions U t U_{t} into Γ t \Gamma_{t} by embedding k k -means ( Section B.4 ), the static-analysis check sends definition-nested groups straight to Deterministic Automation, and the router then chooses which group G t ∈ Γ t G_{t}\in\Gamma_{t} to buy a computation for; T T is the deterministic update of Equation 2 . DefNested is the static-analysis check: a goal whose obstruction is only unfolded definitions is dispatched to Deterministic Automation without a routing call, but only when that action itself passes the guards—after a no-progress automation attempt on an unchanged goal the guards exclude it, and the goal is routed instead— and Amend is the router’s revision of its own rules ρ t \rho_{t} after observing an outcome. Guards evaluates the mechanically checkable admissibility conditions (contract membership, acyclicity, available identifiers, no identical deterministic repetition); r max r_{\max} bounds the router calls in one epoch, so deliberation is finite even when decisions are repeatedly malformed. Default is the deterministic fallback used when that bound is reached: the admissible triple with the lowest contract cost bound ( i.e. , Deterministic Automation whenever it is admissible) with groups ordered by d σ d_{\sigma} then statement hash, agents by a fixed order, and an empty analysis j j .
paragraphs.zh: 操作符如下。 在 𝒟 t \mathcal{D}_{t} 上传播关闭工件状态：一个稳定的辅助引理会释放其消费者，而被拒绝或修改的临时工件会标记其条件后代为无效。 Open ​ ( 𝔊 t ) \textsc{Open}(\mathfrak{G}_{t}) 是开放 AND 节点的集合；Prereq ​ ( g ) \textsc{Prereq}(g) 是 𝒟 t \mathcal{D}_{t} 中活跃前提条件的集合；Elaborated ​ ( σ t ) \textsc{Elaborated}(\sigma_{t}) 是具有已展开声明（稳定或临时）的声明集合，这些声明可用于构建证明，而 Stable ​ ( σ t ) \textsc{Stable}(\sigma_{t}) 是其中可被提升的较小集合；RootDisc ​ ( 𝒟 t ) \textsc{RootDisc}(\mathcal{D}_{t}) 是没有到根节点的依赖路径的引理集合，这些引理会被丢弃；Sched 是方程 1 的结构阶段：它维护前沿并将整个前沿交给智能体路由器，U t = ℱ t U_{t}=\mathcal{F}_{t}。 分组由路由器执行：Cluster 通过嵌入 k k -means（见 B.4 节）将 U t U_{t} 划分为 Γ t \Gamma_{t}；静态分析检查会将定义嵌套组直接发送到确定性自动化，然后路由器选择哪个组 G t ∈ Γ t G_{t}\in\Gamma_{t} 为其购买计算资源；T T 是方程 2 的确定性更新。 DefNested 是静态分析检查：如果一个目标仅因展开定义而受阻，则无需调用路由即可将其派送给确定性自动化，但前提是该操作本身通过守卫条件——在对未改变的目标进行无进展的自动化尝试后，守卫条件会将其排除，此时该目标会被重新路由；Amend 则是路由器在观察到结果后对其自身规则 ρ t \rho_{t} 的修订。 Guards 评估可机械检查的可接受性条件（合同成员资格、无环性、可用标识符、无相同的确定性重复）；r max r_{\max} 限制单个周期内的路由器调用次数，因此即使决策反复出现错误，推理过程也是有限的。 Default 是在达到上述限制时使用的确定性回退方案：选择合同成本边界最低的可接受三元组（即，只要可接受，就使用确定性自动化），其中组按 d σ d_{\sigma} 和声明哈希排序，智能体按固定顺序排列，分析 j j 为空。

paragraphs.en: The scheduler discharges the selection half of the metalevel symbolically: it maintains the dependency-ready frontier and hands it to the router in full , so no model call is spent on selection. Algorithm 2 states the maintenance precisely. The frontier is kept by an incremental Kahn pass [ 18 ] over the dynamic dependency graph 𝒟 t \mathcal{D}_{t} : for every lemma/theorem ℓ \ell , the scheduler keeps the unelaborated in-degree d ⁡ ( ℓ ) d(\ell) and the frontier ℱ t \mathcal{F}_{t} consists exactly of the open AND nodes of declarations with d ⁡ ( ℓ ) = 0 d(\ell)=0 , minus root-disconnected work. A second counter, the unstable in-degree d σ ​ ( ℓ ) d_{\sigma}(\ell) , counts every prerequisite that is not yet stable, elaborated or not: it does not gate the frontier, but d σ ​ ( ℓ ) = 0 d_{\sigma}(\ell)=0 marks the declarations whose proofs can be promoted, and the scheduler orders the frontier by it, so unconditional work is preferred to conditional work. Kahn’s algorithm processes zero-in-degree nodes of a static graph but here the graph changes as lemmas are added, elaborated, stabilized, and retracted, so the counters are updated per event at cost proportional to the affected out-degree. Elaborating u u decrements d ⁡ ( ℓ ) d(\ell) for each consumer ℓ \ell and releases those reaching zero; stabilizing u u decrements d σ ​ ( ℓ ) d_{\sigma}(\ell) and enables promotion; retracting u u reopens exactly its conditional descendants and restores their counters rather than re-sorting the graph. Two properties of the frontier follow from its definition and carry the scheduler’s cost rationale: work with no dependency path to a root never enters it, and no goal is opened beneath a prerequisite that has not even been elaborated. Work beneath a provisional prerequisite is admitted and its exposure is what Equation 19 measures and the Recovery Reviewer unwinds.
paragraphs.zh: 调度器以符号化方式处理元层的选择部分：它维护依赖就绪的前沿，并将其完整交给路由器，因此无需消耗任何模型调用进行选择。 算法 2 精确描述了该维护过程。 前沿通过动态依赖图 𝒟 t \mathcal{D}_{t} 上的增量 Kahn 遍历 [18] 来维护：对于每个引理/定理 ℓ \ell，调度器保留未展开的入度 d⁡(ℓ) d(\ell)，而前沿 ℱ t \mathcal{F}_{t} 恰好由满足 d⁡(ℓ) = 0 d(\ell)=0 的声明中开放的 AND 节点组成，并排除与根节点断开的工作。 第二个计数器——不稳定入度 d σ ​ ( ℓ ) d_{\sigma}(\ell)——统计所有尚未稳定的前提条件，无论其是否已展开：它不直接控制前沿，但 d σ ​ ( ℓ ) = 0 d_{\sigma}(\ell)=0 会标记那些证明可以被提升的声明，调度器据此对前沿进行排序，从而优先处理无条件工作而非有条件工作。 Kahn 算法处理静态图中入度为零的节点，但在此处，随着引理被添加、展开、稳定和撤销，图会发生变化，因此计数器会在每个事件发生时更新，其成本与受影响的出度成正比。 展开 u u 会使每个消费者 ℓ \ell 的 d⁡(ℓ) d(\ell) 减一，并释放那些入度达到零的节点；稳定化 u u 会减少 d σ ​ ( ℓ ) d_{\sigma}(\ell)，并允许提升；撤销 u u 会重新开放恰好是其条件后代的节点，并恢复它们的计数器，而不是重新排序整个图。 根据前沿的定义，可以推导出两个属性，这些属性也体现了调度器的成本逻辑：没有到根节点的依赖路径的工作永远不会进入前沿，且没有任何目标会在一个甚至尚未展开的前提条件下被打开。 临时前提条件下的工作会被允许加入，而它的暴露状态正是方程 19 所测量的内容，也是恢复审查器需要回滚的部分。

paragraphs.en: Batching reduces the cost of router and specialist invocations: a single call jointly analyzes several related goals, and proposals for shared helpers draw evidence from multiple potential consumers. These savings, however, depend on grouping goals that are genuinely related. The router forms such groups, on the frontier the scheduler hands it, by applying k k -means clustering to semantic embeddings of the normalized goal statements. DreamProver [ 56 ] uses the similar clustering method but they use it to evolve lemmas.
paragraphs.zh: 批量处理可以降低路由器和专家调用的成本：单次调用会联合分析多个相关目标，而为共享辅助工具提出的方案则会从多个潜在使用者中获取证据。 然而，这些节省效果取决于将真正相关的目标进行分组。 路由器通过对其调度器所传递的边界上的目标陈述的语义嵌入应用 k 均值聚类，来形成这样的分组。 DreamProver [56] 使用了类似的聚类方法，但他们将其用于演化引理。

paragraphs.en: Embedding and similarity. Each open goal g ∈ ℱ t g\in\mathcal{F}_{t} is rendered as its normalized statement using the tactic state and embedded with the Lean-statement embedding model of Lean Finder [ 30 ] , which is trained on formal Lean statements. Writing ϕ ⁡ ( g ) ∈ ℝ d \phi(g)\in\mathbb{R}^{d} for the raw embedding, we store the unit-normalized vector x g = ϕ ⁡ ( g ) / ∥ ϕ ⁡ ( g ) ∥ 2 x_{g}=\phi(g)/\lVert\phi(g)\rVert_{2} in an index keyed by the statement hash, so embeddings are computed once per normalized statement and reused as the frontier evolves. Similarity between goals is cosine similarity: sim ⁡ ( g , g ′ ) = ⟨ x g , x g ′ ⟩ \mathrm{sim}(g,g^{\prime})=\langle x_{g},x_{g^{\prime}}\rangle .

paragraphs.en: Because both x g x_{g} and μ j \mu_{j} lie on the unit sphere and an unconstrained mean centroid has ∥ x g − μ j ∥ 2 2 = 1 + ∥ μ j ∥ 2 2 − 2 ​ ⟨ x g , μ j ⟩ \lVert x_{g}-\mu_{j}\rVert_{2}^{2}=1+\lVert\mu_{j}\rVert_{2}^{2}-2\langle x_{g},\mu_{j}\rangle , we have ∥ x g − μ j ∥ 2 2 = 2 − 2 ​ ⟨ x g , μ j ⟩ \lVert x_{g}-\mu_{j}\rVert_{2}^{2}=2-2\langle x_{g},\mu_{j}\rangle , so minimizing Equation 17 is equivalent to maximizing within-cluster cosine similarity, under the similarity the index already uses. We run Lloyd’s iteration: initialize centroids by k k -means ++ seeding from a fixed seed derived from the hash of the frontier, so that the grouping is a deterministic function of the state. We repeat: (i) assign each x g x_{g} to its nearest centroid and (ii) update each μ j \mu_{j} to the mean of its cluster, re-normalized to the unit sphere; stop when assignments are unchanged. paragraphs.en: CoCo-Prover treats the router’s context as the head of the conversation that the chosen agent continues, rather than as a separate request. Concretely, a routing decision hands the action agent the router’s message history together with the preliminary analysis j j that the router produced while making the decision. The agent appends its own turns to that history instead of opening a fresh one, so the shared prefix is served from the provider’s prompt cache at the cache-hit price, and the agent inherits the router’s reading of the goals rather than re-deriving it. The ledger records cached and uncached input tokens separately, so the realized effect of this reuse is visible in the reported costs rather than assumed.
paragraphs.zh: CoCo-Prover 将路由器的上下文视为所选智能体继续的对话开端，而非一个独立请求。 具体而言，路由决策会将路由器的消息历史以及路由器在做出决策时生成的初步分析 j j 一并交给动作智能体。 该智能体将自己的回合追加到该历史中，而不是开启一个新的对话，因此共享前缀会从提供商的提示缓存中以缓存命中价格获取，而智能体则会继承路由器对目标的解读，而非重新推导。 账本会分别记录已缓存和未缓存的输入标记，因此这种重复使用的实际影响会体现在报告的成本中，而非被默认假设。

paragraphs.en: A helper lemma proposed by the Lemma Planner enters the dependency graph only after it elaborates and preserves acyclicity, but elaboration only establishes that the statement is well-formed, not that it is true. Committing to a false helper lemma is expensive: consumers are proved against it, and the work beneath it must be discarded when Lean eventually refuses the proof. CoCo-Prover therefore tries to refute a candidate before any proof effort is spent on it, in two escalating steps.
paragraphs.zh: 由引理规划器提出的辅助引理，只有在经过详细展开并保持无环性之后才会进入依赖图，但详细展开仅能确立该陈述是形式正确的，而非其正确性。 采用错误的辅助引理代价高昂：系统会针对它进行证明验证，而当 Lean 最终拒绝该证明时，其下方的所有工作都必须被舍弃。 因此，CoCo-Prover 会在投入任何证明努力之前，通过两个逐步升级的步骤尝试反驳候选引理。

paragraphs.en: Step 1: random testing. For a candidate whose statement is executable, we sample concrete values for its universally quantified variables, instantiate the statement, and evaluate it. This is cheap, requires no model call, and catches the common failures of a plausible-looking conjecture such as a missing side condition, an off-by-one bound, or a hypothesis that the planner assumed but never stated. A single falsifying instance disproves the lemma outright.
paragraphs.zh: 步骤 1：随机测试。 对于一个陈述可执行的候选项，我们会为其全称量词变量采样具体值，实例化该陈述并进行评估。 这种方法成本低廉，无需调用模型，并且能够发现看似合理但实际存在问题的猜想中的常见错误，例如缺少侧条件、边界值偏差一，或是规划器假设了却从未明确说明的某个命题。 一个反例就能直接推翻该引理。

sents.zh: 步骤 1：随机测试。

paragraphs.en: Step 2: LLM-proposed structured instances. Random sampling explores the space uniformly and rarely reaches the corner cases where verification conditions actually fail: a singleton, an index at the boundary, an overflow value, or the state just before and after a loop’s last iteration. Constructing those instances takes reasoning about the statement rather than sampling, so when Step 1 finds no counterexample, we ask a model to propose a small set of structured instances, and evaluate them the same way. Step 2 runs only if Step 1 passes, so its cost is paid only for candidates that have already survived the free check.
paragraphs.zh: 步骤 2：由 LLM 提出的结构化实例。 随机采样以均匀方式探索整个空间，但很少能触及验证条件真正失效的边界情况：例如单元素集合、边界处的索引、溢出值，或循环最后一次迭代之前和之后的状态。 构造这些实例需要对语句本身进行推理，而非依赖采样；因此，当步骤 1 未找到反例时，我们会让模型提出一组小型结构化实例，并以相同方式对其进行评估。 只有步骤 1 通过时，步骤 2 才会执行，因此其成本仅针对已通过免费检查的候选项产生。

sents.zh: 步骤 2：由 LLM 提出的结构化实例。

paragraphs.en: If either step produces a counterexample, the candidate is rejected. The counterexamples, with the instance that triggered it, are returned to the Lemma Planner, which refines the statement, most often by strengthening a hypothesis or restricting a bound, and proposes a revised lemma. If both steps pass, the lemma is admitted to the dependency graph as provisional . Passing these checks is evidence rather than a guarantee: testing can refute a candidate but cannot promote it, and only Lean acceptance makes a declaration stable.
paragraphs.zh: 如果任意一步产生反例，该候选项将被拒绝。 这些反例连同触发它们的实例会被返回给引理规划器，后者会改进该陈述——通常通过加强假设或限制界限——并提出修订后的引理。 如果两步都通过，该引理将以临时状态被纳入依赖图。 通过这些检查只是证据而非保证：测试可以否定候选项，但无法使其成为有效项；只有 Lean 的接受才能使声明变得稳定。

paragraphs.en: Experiment setup. Every method runs under the same external limits: each function-level problem is capped at 5 hours of wall-clock time and $30 of expenditure (including NTP4VC since one task has one obligation in its benchmark design), and each repository-level task at 8 hours and $60. All methods access each backbone model through the same official provider: Gemini-3.5-Flash via Google Vertex AI, GPT-5.6-Terra via OpenAI, and DeepSeek-V4-Flash via DeepSeek, so token prices and caching behavior are identical across methods. Cost is measured the same way for every method: we collect the token counts of every model call by type (uncached input, cached input, cache write, and output tokens, with reasoning tokens billed as output) and convert them to US dollars under the provider’s official pricing ( Table 4 ). All experiments run on a machine with 16 vCPUs and 256 GB of memory, which hosts Lean checking and all local computation while model inference runs through the provider APIs, with 12 concurrent prover runs. We use Lean Finder [ 30 ] as the retrieval tool for the methods and deploy it as a service on a machine with 4 vCPUs, 16 GB of memory and one NVIDIA L4 GPU. After each run, the generated Lean proof is checked by the independent Lean proof reviewer checker described below.

paragraphs.en: Hilbert [ 48 ] was built for MiniF2F and PutnamBench, where a problem is a self-contained theorem: the file header holds only import Mathlib , open declarations, and set_option lines, and everything the theorem mentions is Mathlib vocabulary the model already knows. Program verification benchmarks break this assumption. Their header carries the actual mathematical content— def implementation and def problem_spec —and the theorem is a single line that refers to these definitions. Hilbert’s decomposition does not treat the header as part of the problem, and this also causes the wasted assemblies we observed: when stating a subgoal, the model adds hypotheses about implementation , not recognizing it as a concrete definition it could unfold, so the subgoal’s signature no longer matches its use site and the sketch fails to assemble.
paragraphs.zh: Hilbert [ 48 ] 是为 MiniF2F 和 PutnamBench 构建的，其中一个问题是一个自包含的定理：文件头仅包含 import Mathlib、open 声明和 set_option 行，而该定理提到的所有内容都是模型已经熟悉的 Mathlib 词汇。 程序验证基准测试打破了这一假设。 它们的文件头包含了实际的数学内容——def implementation 和 def problem_spec——而该定理只是一行引用这些定义的代码。 Hilbert 的分解方法未将文件头视为问题的一部分，这也导致了我们所观察到的冗余组合：在陈述子目标时，模型会添加关于 implementation 的假设，而没有将其识别为可以展开的具体定义，因此子目标的签名不再与其使用位置匹配，导致草图无法成功组合。

paragraphs.en: Goedel-Code-Prover [ 23 ] relies mainly on its own fine-tuned model; its agentic framework is a simple pipeline of lemma decomposition and iterative refinement whose effectiveness comes from sampling many model answers. Under our protocol—one attempt per problem (pass@1) with a frontier backbone such as Gemini-3.5-Flash—it failed to prove problems within a $5 budget that both CoCo-Prover and the coding agents prove for under $0.50 each. Given this gap, which stems from a framework designed around a fine-tuned model and repeated sampling rather than from the backbone, a matched-budget comparison would not be informative.
paragraphs.zh: Goedel-Code-Prover [ 23 ] 主要依赖其自身经过微调的模型；其智能体框架是一个简单的引理分解与迭代优化流程，其有效性源于对大量模型答案的采样。 在我们的协议下——每个问题仅尝试一次（pass@1），并使用 Gemini-3.5-Flash 等前沿基础模型——它未能以 5 美元预算证明那些 CoCo-Prover 和编码智能体各自以不到 0.50 美元就能证明的问题。 鉴于这一差距源于围绕微调模型和重复采样设计的框架，而非基础模型本身，因此进行预算匹配的比较将缺乏信息价值。

paragraphs.en: Lean proof reviewer checker. A run counts as solved only if its proof survives an independent review, applied identically to CoCo-Prover and to every baseline. The review is needed because a failing agent can end a run in ways that compile but prove nothing: leaving a placeholder, quietly editing the theorem it was asked to prove, or assuming the goal as a new axiom. After a run finishes, we take the produced Lean file and apply five checks, the first three mechanical, the last two aimed at proofs that pass the mechanical checks yet are not genuine.
paragraphs.zh: Lean 证明审查检查器。 只有当一次运行的证明通过独立审查时，该运行才被视为成功；且这一审查对 CoCo-Prover 和所有基线方法均一视同仁。 之所以需要审查，是因为一个失效的智能体可能以看似通过编译但并未真正证明任何内容的方式结束运行：例如留下占位符、悄悄修改被要求证明的定理，或将目标作为新公理直接假设成立。 运行结束后，我们会取生成的 Lean 文件并执行五项检查：前三项为机械化检查，后两项则针对那些通过机械化检查但并非真正有效的证明。

sents.zh: Lean 证明审查检查器。

sents.en: After a run finishes, we take the produced Lean file and apply five checks, the first three mechanical, the last two aimed at proofs that pass the mechanical checks yet are not genuine.

paragraphs.en: No unsolved goals. We re-elaborate the file with the Lean checker and reject any run whose target theorems still contain an unproved hole, whether written as sorry or admit , or left open by a placeholder tactic such as apply? ; the elaborator’s own sorry -containing and error warnings are treated as failures rather than diagnostics.
paragraphs.zh: 没有未解决的目标。 我们使用 Lean 检查器重新处理该文件，并拒绝任何目标定理仍包含未证明的空洞的运行，无论这些空洞是写成 sorry 还是 admit，或是被 apply? 等占位符战术留下的开放状态；精化器自身包含 sorry 的警告和错误提示被视为失败，而非诊断信息。

sents.en: No unsolved goals.
sents.zh: 没有未解决的目标。

sents.en: We re-elaborate the file with the Lean checker and reject any run whose target theorems still contain an unproved hole, whether written as sorry or admit , or left open by a placeholder tactic such as apply? ; the elaborator’s own sorry -containing and error warnings are treated as failures rather than diagnostics.
sents.zh: 我们使用 Lean 检查器重新处理该文件，并拒绝任何目标定理仍包含未证明的空洞的运行，无论这些空洞是写成 sorry 还是 admit，或是被 apply? 等占位符战术留下的开放状态；精化器自身包含 sorry 的警告和错误提示被视为失败，而非诊断信息。

paragraphs.en: Unmodified statements. The theorem the agent proves must be the theorem it was given. We compare each target declaration against the benchmark original by string match on the statement and by re-elaborating it in the benchmark environment, so a weakened hypothesis, a renamed constant, a changed binder, or a restated conclusion is rejected even when the accompanying proof compiles.
paragraphs.zh: 未经修改的陈述。 智能体所证明的定理必须就是它被赋予的那个定理。 我们将每个目标声明与基准原始声明进行比较：通过字符串匹配陈述本身，并在基准环境中重新展开它；因此，即使伴随的证明能够通过编译，弱化假设、重命名常量、更改绑定符或重述结论的情况仍会被拒绝。

sents.en: Unmodified statements.
sents.zh: 未经修改的陈述。

sents.en: The theorem the agent proves must be the theorem it was given.
sents.zh: 智能体所证明的定理必须就是它被赋予的那个定理。

sents.en: We compare each target declaration against the benchmark original by string match on the statement and by re-elaborating it in the benchmark environment, so a weakened hypothesis, a renamed constant, a changed binder, or a restated conclusion is rejected even when the accompanying proof compiles.
sents.zh: 我们将每个目标声明与基准原始声明进行比较：通过字符串匹配陈述本身，并在基准环境中重新展开它；因此，即使伴随的证明能够通过编译，弱化假设、重命名常量、更改绑定符或重述结论的情况仍会被拒绝。

paragraphs.en: No new axioms. We ask the Lean checker for the axioms each target theorem’s proof actually depends on and require that set to lie within the benchmark’s own environment. A proof that introduces an axiom , admits a declaration through an axiomatic definition, or otherwise extends the trusted base is rejected.
paragraphs.zh: 没有新的公理。 我们要求 Lean 检查器提供每个目标定理的证明实际依赖的公理，并要求该集合位于基准测试自身的环境内。 任何引入公理、通过公理定义进行声明，或以其他方式扩展可信基础的证明都将被拒绝。

sents.en: No new axioms.
sents.zh: 没有新的公理。

sents.en: We ask the Lean checker for the axioms each target theorem’s proof actually depends on and require that set to lie within the benchmark’s own environment.
sents.zh: 我们要求 Lean 检查器提供每个目标定理的证明实际依赖的公理，并要求该集合位于基准测试自身的环境内。

sents.en: A proof that introduces an axiom , admits a declaration through an axiomatic definition, or otherwise extends the trusted base is rejected.
sents.zh: 任何引入公理、通过公理定义进行声明，或以其他方式扩展可信基础的证明都将被拒绝。

paragraphs.en: Automated review. The three checks above are syntactic, so we additionally run Codex with GPT-5.6-Sol over each accepted proof, with the original statement and the produced file, and ask it to report placeholders, unproved obligations, and proofs that are vacuous or only appear to establish the statement. Any proof it flags is re-examined by hand.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化审查。 上述三项检查均为句法层面的检查，因此我们还使用 Codex 配合 GPT-5.6-Sol 对每个被接受的证明进行额外分析，输入包括原始命题和生成的文件，并要求其报告占位符、未证明的义务，以及空洞或仅看似证明了该命题的证明。 任何被标记出的证明都会由人工重新审查。

sents.en: Automated review.
sents.zh: 自动化审查。

sents.en: The three checks above are syntactic, so we additionally run Codex with GPT-5.6-Sol over each accepted proof, with the original statement and the produced file, and ask it to report placeholders, unproved obligations, and proofs that are vacuous or only appear to establish the statement.
sents.zh: 上述三项检查均为句法层面的检查，因此我们还使用 Codex 配合 GPT-5.6-Sol 对每个被接受的证明进行额外分析，输入包括原始命题和生成的文件，并要求其报告占位符、未证明的义务，以及空洞或仅看似证明了该命题的证明。

sents.en: Any proof it flags is re-examined by hand.
sents.zh: 任何被标记出的证明都会由人工重新审查。

paragraphs.en: Manual audit. Finally, we sample passing proofs at random across benchmarks, methods, and backbones and inspect them manually to confirm that they are genuine and that the preceding checks are not missing a failure mode.
paragraphs.zh: 人工审计。 最后，我们从各个基准测试、方法和基础模型中随机抽样通过验证的证明，并进行人工检查，以确认这些证明是真实的，并且前面的检查没有遗漏任何失效模式。

sents.en: Manual audit.
sents.zh: 人工审计。

sents.en: Finally, we sample passing proofs at random across benchmarks, methods, and backbones and inspect them manually to confirm that they are genuine and that the preceding checks are not missing a failure mode.
sents.zh: 最后，我们从各个基准测试、方法和基础模型中随机抽样通过验证的证明，并进行人工检查，以确认这些证明是真实的，并且前面的检查没有遗漏任何失效模式。

paragraphs.en: Every solve rate and cost reported in this paper counts only runs that pass all five checks.
paragraphs.zh: 本论文中报告的所有求解速率和成本仅统计通过全部五项检查的运行。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 opens the CLEVER results into one point per solved problem, comparing CoCo-Prover with the coding agent of each backbone. Two patterns hold across backbones. At comparable wall-clock time its points also lie below the coding agent’s and avoid their high-cost tail, which reaches about $30 per problem under Gemini-3.5-Flash against about $13 for CoCo-Prover. The average cost also covers the harder problems the baselines never solve so it is higher than the coding agents on GPT model. CoCo-Prover has a higher mean wall-clock time under GPT-5.6-Terra and Gemini-3.5-Flash, but a lower mean under DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Thus, wall-clock time is the one axis where CoCo-Prover does not win: a coding agent writes a whole proof in one shot, whereas CoCo-Prover selects, routes, and Lean-checks one goal before purchasing the next. That sequential, verified progress is what keeps cost low but it takes longer, which is also discussed in Appendix F .
paragraphs.zh: 图 5 将 CLEVER 的结果按每个已解决的问题汇总为一个点，并将 CoCo-Prover 与每个基础模型对应的编码智能体进行比较。 在所有基础模型中均存在两种模式。 在可比较的墙钟时间下，其数据点也位于编码智能体的数据点下方，并避开了后者的高成本尾部；在 Gemini-3.5-Flash 上，该尾部成本约为每个问题 30 美元，而 CoCo-Prover 的成本则约为 13 美元。 平均成本还涵盖了基础模型从未解决的更难问题，因此其成本高于基于 GPT 模型的编码智能体。 在 GPT-5.6-Terra 和 Gemini-3.5-Flash 上，CoCo-Prover 的平均墙钟时间更长，但在 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 上则更短。 因此，墙钟时间是 CoCo-Prover 未能占优的唯一维度：编码智能体可一次性写出完整证明，而 CoCo-Prover 则需要先选择一个目标、进行路由并执行 Lean 检查，然后再购买下一个目标。 正是这种顺序且经过验证的进展过程使成本保持较低，但也导致了更长的耗时，相关内容亦在附录 F 中进行了讨论。

paragraphs.en: The gap between CoCo-Prover and the baselines is widest under DeepSeek-V4-Flash, and the reason is that the baselines are not built for how this model spends its reasoning budget. Two of the three baseline families run inside an agent scaffold designed around another provider’s model. Humanize is built on general coding agents such as Codex and Claude Code, so running it on DeepSeek-V4-Flash means driving a Codex-shaped loop with a model the loop was not tuned for. The coding-agent baseline uses DeepSeek’s own harness, which is the intended scaffold but still gives the model one large context holding the whole task. Both arrangements share the same assumption: the model is asked to reason about a long context and produce a proof in one turn.
paragraphs.zh: 在 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 模型下，CoCo-Prover 与基线模型之间的差距最大，原因是这些基线模型并未针对该模型推理预算的分配方式进行构建。 三个基线模型家族中有两个是在围绕另一家提供商的模型设计的智能体框架内运行的。 Humanize 是建立在 Codex 和 Claude Code 等通用编码智能体之上的，因此将其运行在 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 上，意味着用一个未针对该循环进行调优的模型来驱动一个以 Codex 为模板的循环。 编码智能体基线模型使用了 DeepSeek 自身的工具集，这是预期的框架，但仍然让模型在一个大型上下文中处理整个任务。 这两种安排都基于相同的假设：模型被要求对长上下文进行推理，并在单次交互中生成证明。

paragraphs.en: DeepSeek-V4-Flash usually has long reasoning traces and spends much of its wall-clock budget inside them, and the effect compounds in an agentic setting, where each turn carries the accumulated transcript. We observe two resulting failure modes. In the first, a run is still reasoning when the wall-clock cap expires. In the second, the model finishes reasoning and then declines the task, reporting that the goal is too hard or that it cannot complete the proof. Both leave the run unsolved after real spending, which is why the cost saving on commonly solved problems is largest there.
paragraphs.zh: DeepSeek-V4-Flash 通常会产生较长的推理轨迹，并消耗大量实际运行时间在这些轨迹中；在智能体设置下，这种效应会进一步加剧，因为每一步都会携带累积的对话记录。 我们观察到由此产生的两种失败模式。 在第一种模式中，当实际运行时间达到上限时，智能体仍在进行推理。 在第二种模式中，模型完成推理后却拒绝执行任务，并报告目标过于困难或无法完成证明。 这两种情况都导致智能体在真实消耗资源后仍未能解决问题，因此，在通常能解决的问题上，成本节省效果最为显著。

paragraphs.en: However, CoCo-Prover’s fine-grained control on proof graphs supplies exactly that: the router fixes a reasoning effort and working budget per invocation, and each specialist sees only its own goals with the prepared context it needs. This is why the framework can transfer across backbone LLMs.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，CoCo-Prover 对证明图的精细控制恰好提供了这一点：路由器每次调用都会固定推理努力和计算预算，而每个专家只能看到自己的目标以及所需的已准备上下文。 这就是该框架能够跨不同基础大语言模型迁移的原因。

paragraphs.en: Model outputs are stochastic, so a single run can overstate or understate a system’s cost. We measure this variance at two scales: over the three function-level benchmarks in full, which tells us whether the headline results rest on a lucky run, and over the 30-problem ablation subset, which sets the noise floor against which a component ablation must be read. Both use the same provider, caps, and proof-review procedure as the main evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 模型输出具有随机性，因此单次运行可能会高估或低估系统的成本。 我们在两个尺度上衡量这种方差：首先是在全部三个函数级基准测试上，这能告诉我们主要结果是否依赖于一次幸运的运行；其次是在包含30个问题的消融子集上，这为组件消融分析设定了必须参照的噪声基线。 两者均与主评估使用相同的提供商、上限和证明审查流程。

sents.zh: 模型输出具有随机性，因此单次运行可能会高估或低估系统的成本。

sents.en: We measure this variance at two scales: over the three function-level benchmarks in full, which tells us whether the headline results rest on a lucky run, and over the 30-problem ablation subset, which sets the noise floor against which a component ablation must be read.
sents.zh: 我们在两个尺度上衡量这种方差：首先是在全部三个函数级基准测试上，这能告诉我们主要结果是否依赖于一次幸运的运行；其次是在包含30个问题的消融子集上，这为组件消融分析设定了必须参照的噪声基线。

sents.en: Both use the same provider, caps, and proof-review procedure as the main evaluation.
sents.zh: 两者均与主评估使用相同的提供商、上限和证明审查流程。

paragraphs.en: Full function-level benchmarks. We run the complete CoCo-Prover three times with Gemini-3.5-Flash on all of CLEVER, VERINA, and AlgoVeri, 427 problems in total. Total cost over the three benchmarks is $969.8 on average with a standard deviation of $89.5, a coefficient of variation of 9.2%. The spread is therefore an order of magnitude smaller than the cost gaps the comparison rests on ( Table 2 ), so the reported savings are not an artifact of which run we report. The solved set is identical across the three runs on all three benchmarks, so the solve rates of Table 1 are stable and the variance is in cost alone.
paragraphs.zh: 完整的函数级基准测试。 我们在所有 CLEVER、VERINA 和 AlgoVeri 数据集上，使用 Gemini-3.5-Flash 完整运行 CoCo-Prover 三次，总共处理了 427 个问题。 三项基准测试的总成本平均为 969.8 美元，标准差为 89.5 美元，变异系数为 9.2%。 因此，这种差异比比较所依据的成本差距（表 2）小一个数量级，所以报告的成本节省并非取决于我们报告了哪次运行结果。 在所有三项基准测试中，三次运行的已解决问题集完全相同，因此表 1 中的解决率是稳定的，方差仅体现在成本上。

sents.zh: 完整的函数级基准测试。
